shortDescription: Creates or removes interfaces from virtual machines in Nautobot

options.name: api_version
options.description: API Version Nautobot REST API

options.name: custom_fields
options.description: Must exist in Nautobot and in key/value format

options.name: description
options.description: The description of the interface

options.name: enabled
options.description: Sets whether interface shows enabled or disabled

options.name: id
options.description: The UUID of the object to operate on

options.name: ip_addresses
options.description: List of IP addresses to associate with this VM interface.

options.name: mac_address
options.description: The MAC address of the interface

options.name: mode
options.description: The mode of the interface

options.name: mtu
options.description: The MTU of the interface

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the interface to be created Required if I(state=present) and the interface does not exist yet

options.name: query_params
options.description: This can be used to override the specified values in ALLOWED_QUERY_PARAMS that is defined in plugins/module_utils/utils.py and provides control to users on what may make an object unique in their environment.

options.name: role
options.description: The role of the interface

options.name: state
options.description: Use C(present) or C(absent) for adding or removing.

options.name: status
options.description: The status of the interface. Required if I(state=present) and does not exist yet

options.name: tagged_vlans
options.description: A list of tagged VLANS to be assigned to interface. Mode must be set to either C(Tagged) or C(Tagged All)

options.name: tags
options.description: Any tags that this item may need to be associated with

options.name: token
options.description: The token created within Nautobot to authorize API access Can be omitted if the E(NAUTOBOT_TOKEN) environment variable is configured.

options.name: untagged_vlan
options.description: The untagged VLAN to be assigned to interface

options.name: url
options.description: The URL of the Nautobot instance resolvable by the Ansible host (for example: http://nautobot.example.com:8000) Can be omitted if the E(NAUTOBOT_URL) environment variable is configured.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Can be omitted if the E(NAUTOBOT_VALIDATE_CERTS) environment variable is configured.

options.name: virtual_machine
options.description: Name of the virtual machine the interface will be associated with (case-sensitive) Required if I(state=present) and the interface does not exist yet

options.name: vrf
options.description: The VRF assigned to the interface
